notes: Hybrid Production Pipeline Engine Registry for XDX Autonomous Video Studio v3.3. Reflects honest runtime availability and live verification status.

entries.name: Blender 3D via XDX Blender Studio MCP (Vivo X200 Pro / Cloud Relay)
entries.role: Hero/supporting character modeling, rigging/IK, acting animation, stylized diorama environments, PBR lighting, and cinematic shot rendering
entries.limitations: Local Blender binary is not installed inside cloud VM; rendering executes on paired Android Vivo X200 Pro (Dimensity 9400 + Immortalis-G925) via Outbound Relay (HTTPS/Tailscale) or USB ADB with mobile_guard (<=4 Cycles threads, <=640px rendered preview).

entries.name: Three.js Deterministic Procedural 3D & VFX Engine (v0.187.0)
entries.role: Procedural 3D dioramas, simulations, technical/scientific/historical cutaways, 3D charts, particles, and deterministic camera motion
entries.limitations: Never use requestAnimationFrame wall-clock deltas for production export; step strictly by frame / fps.

entries.name: Remotion Master Timeline & Compositor Engine (v4.0)
entries.role: Master frame-based timeline [start_frame, end_frame), multi-layer compositing, editing, animated captions, audio ducking/mixing, 2D motion graphics, and transitions
entries.limitations: Chromium headless rendering runs in Cloud Linux VM (recommended for Android-only users without a PC); Remotion License applies to entities >3 people.

entries.name: REA-Video Reference Intelligence & Visual QC Engine
entries.role: Reference video shot boundary detection, camera/pacing/staging forensics, contact sheet extraction, and post-render visual QC comparison
entries.limitations: Offline baseline + OpenCV adaptive detector are installed and tested; upstream rea-video ONNX stem-separation/OCR/VLM CLI is optional and not pre-downloaded to avoid unapproved external model downloads.

entries.name: FFmpeg / FFprobe Media Processing & Validation Engine (v6.1.1)
entries.role: H.264 yuv420p + AAC 48kHz encoding, WAV audio inspection, loudness/peak measurement, scene extraction, and full stream decode verification
entries.limitations: Used as validator/encoder, never as a silent replacement for 3D engines without explicit user approval.
